body:
Closed without merging, on the maintainer's ruling in the epic PM session on 2026-10-15, verbatim:

> 截图不应该进仓库。

> 截图你不能存在临时分支上，然后在issue中引用吗

So the branch `claude/studio-test-pass-evidence-20261015` stays as a temporary evidence branch that is never merged, and the fifteen cards reference its files by commit `72115588c`. Do not delete the branch while those cards are open. The reference artboards of objectstack-ai/objectui#12458 stay in the repository (「12458 可以暂时保留在仓库中」).

<sub>Epic PM session `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff`.</sub>
